xhtml:div.xhtml:div:
SEQUENCE · filled arrow: synchronous call · open arrow: asynchronous message · dashed arrow: reply.
Orange: client/provider · navy: component/service · green: data/cache. Fragments use source predicates; ref expands a subordinate interaction.
Normal indexing view with subordinate policy/failure/retry interactions as refs; page30 owns detailed resume loops and page31 owns commit.
par guards are intentionally empty. Visual and transcript conditions are nested; assembly requires visualReady && transcriptReady.
Throw outcomes in refs terminate the caller path into the failure-handler ref; optional visual skip still sets readiness. NO_AUDIO sends no ASR RPC and creates no ASR segments.
Token gate counts/reversions precede reusable DRAFT embedding lookup and generation. Adaptive section boundary embeddings, if configured, are a different earlier operation.
Logical awaited RabbitMQ RPC abstracts transport envelopes. Source model only; native layout/render/visual acceptance belongs to parent.
